newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Dragonfield says to offer 90 mln shrs in IPO.
newsitem.headline: HK's Dragonfield says to offer 90 mln shrs in IPO.

text.p: Leather garments manufacturer and distributor Dragonfield Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it is offering 90 million new shares at HK$1.00 each in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.
The issue price represents a price/earnings multiple of 7.91 times on a proforma fully diluted basis and 6.43 times on a weighted average basis, the company said.
The IPO will run from April 30 to May 5. Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on May 15, it said.
Lippo Securities Ltd is the sponsor and manager of the issue.
Dragonfield engages in trading and manufacturing of leather garments in Hong Kong and China.
The company has a sales and distribution network of 150 outlets throughout China.

It said net proceeds of HK$78.8 million would be used to expand production facilities in Hong Kong and China, buy processing equipment, set up showrooms and representative offices in China and Eastern Europe, increase processing capacity of dry cleaning services and for working capital.
It said more than half of its materials were sourced from Italy, Finland, Norway and the United Kingdom.
The firm forecasts combined profit after taxation and minority interests but before extraordinary items of not less than HK$42 million for the year ended March 31, 1997.
It posted a 58.6 percent increase in turnover last year, while profit attributable to shareholders increased by 18.4 percent to HK$34.91 million.
